dsh-subscriptions.alertThresholdsHint: Comma separated percentages. Each is announced once per window.
dsh-subscriptions.autoPacingHint: Let recent burn rate influence which account is chosen next.
dsh-subscriptions.codexWebSearchHint: Offer Codex subscription search to the host web service.
dsh-subscriptions.codexWebSearchModelHint: Empty lets the upstream pick its own model.
dsh-subscriptions.connectAnotherHint: Reserve the next free slot for this provider and start the login flow right away
dsh-subscriptions.dashSubtitle: Active subscriptions, cache affinity, ROI analytics, and routing trace
dsh-subscriptions.defaultAccountHint: Used for direct routing and when the automatic pool is off.
dsh-subscriptions.drainBeforeResetHint: Prefer accounts whose remainder would otherwise expire unused at the next reset.
dsh-subscriptions.drainSafetyPercentHint: Never drain an account below this remaining percentage.
dsh-subscriptions.leaseEnabledHint: Prevent two DSH instances from spending the same quota window at once.
dsh-subscriptions.leaseTtlMsHint: A lease that is not renewed within this time is taken over.
dsh-subscriptions.mediaPoolEnabledHint: Controls image/video account rotation separately from the text pool.
dsh-subscriptions.modeBalancedHint: A small pool. Adds warm-up, token refresh, account lease, proxy pool and schedules.
dsh-subscriptions.modeHiddenCount: settings hidden by the current mode
dsh-subscriptions.modeHint: Choose how much of the policy surface the card presents. This only changes what you see first — every stored value stays exactly as it is and can be reached from any mode.
dsh-subscriptions.modePowerHint: Every control the plugin has, including proactive quota guard, routing presets and tool policies.
dsh-subscriptions.modeSimpleHint: One or two accounts. Rotation, cooldown and quota alerts only.
dsh-subscriptions.modeSwitchHint: switch to Power to see them
dsh-subscriptions.modelAccountRulesHint: Array of {provider, pattern, account}. The first matching rule picks the account.
dsh-subscriptions.modelCatalogSourceHint: Catalog source: live, cached or builtin
dsh-subscriptions.modelNamesHint: Presentation only: routing, reasoning and model ids stay unchanged. Reset restores the catalog name.
dsh-subscriptions.modelSearchPlaceholder: Search models by id, name or alias
dsh-subscriptions.namespacedRoutesHint: Register subscriptions-<vendor> so another subscription plugin can serve the same vendor id.
dsh-subscriptions.nativeToolsHint: Expose image, video, web and X search tools backed by the subscription pool.
dsh-subscriptions.onboardingNothingFound: No local CLI credentials found - use the provider login instead
dsh-subscriptions.onboardingStep2: Import credentials your CLI already stored
dsh-subscriptions.onboardingTitle: First run: connect your first account
dsh-subscriptions.policyHint: These controls used to require a settings.yaml edit. Changes apply after saving.
dsh-subscriptions.poolEnabledHint: When off, this account is not selected automatically; it stays available for explicit use only.
dsh-subscriptions.poolModelsHint: Automatic allows every current and future model. None removes this account from model routing. An explicit list permits only checked model ids.
dsh-subscriptions.poolModelsNoCatalog: No model catalog yet; sync models or use Automatic.
dsh-subscriptions.proactiveGuardHint: Refuse a request before it reaches an account that is nearly exhausted.
dsh-subscriptions.proactiveMinRemainingHint: Accounts below this remaining percentage receive no new requests.
dsh-subscriptions.promptCacheTtlMinutesHint: Keep a session on the same account this long to reuse the provider prompt cache. 0 disables the affinity.
dsh-subscriptions.proxyPoolCooldownMsHint: How long a failing pool entry is skipped.
dsh-subscriptions.proxyPoolHint: Used when an account has no proxy of its own. Failures cool an entry down.
dsh-subscriptions.refreshAheadMsHint: Start a background refresh this many seconds before a token expires.
dsh-subscriptions.refreshRetryMsHint: How long to wait before retrying a failed token refresh.
dsh-subscriptions.routingPresetsHint: Named bundles of model, reasoning effort, account rule and fallback chain.
dsh-subscriptions.scheduleRulesHint: Array of weekday and time windows that restrict which accounts may serve a request.
dsh-subscriptions.searchModels: Search models by name or id
dsh-subscriptions.selfHealIntervalMinHint: Probe cooled-down accounts in the background this often. 0 disables self-healing.
dsh-subscriptions.showSpeedToggleHint: Show the Speed button in the composer toolbar. Hiding it does not change the selected speed mode.
dsh-subscriptions.showSubsPillHint: Show the SUBS subscription indicator in the chat header. Hiding it keeps tracking, rotation and quotas active.
dsh-subscriptions.sidebarQuotaDisplayHint: Controls quota meter display above Settings ('off', 'auto', or 'always').
dsh-subscriptions.switchAtRemainingHint: Rotate to the next account before this percentage of quota remains. 0 disables the preemptive switch.
dsh-subscriptions.tiersHint: Group accounts into tiers with independent member selection.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncAllowPrivateHint: Permit loopback and private hosts for WebDAV, Gist and S3 targets.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncAutoPushHint: Upload a fresh snapshot whenever an account completes authorisation.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncEnabledHint: Push the encrypted credential snapshot to remote storage.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncGistBaseUrlHint: Change for Gitea or a self-hosted instance.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncGistIdHint: Leave empty to create a new secret gist on first push.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncGistTokenHint: Token with gist scope. Stored as a secret.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncIntervalHoursHint: How often the background loop pulls or pushes. 0 disables the loop.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncPassphraseHint: Used to encrypt the snapshot before upload. Stored as a secret.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncProvidersHint: Empty syncs every provider. List ids to restrict the snapshot.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncS3AccessKeyHint: Access key id for the bucket.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncS3BucketHint: Bucket that receives the encrypted snapshot.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncS3EndpointHint: Custom endpoint for MinIO or R2. Empty uses AWS.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncS3SecretKeyHint: Stored as a secret and never returned to the browser.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncTimeoutMsHint: Abort a remote sync request after this long.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncWebdavPasswordHint: Stored as a secret and never returned to the browser.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncWebdavUrlHint: Full collection URL, for example a Nextcloud remote.php/dav path.
dsh-subscriptions.vaultSyncWebdavUsernameHint: Basic authentication user for the WebDAV target.
dsh-subscriptions.warmupAtHint: Refresh and probe every account once a day at this local time. Empty disables the schedule.
dsh-subscriptions.webhookAllowPrivateHint: Permit loopback and private network URLs. Off by default to avoid SSRF.
